other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow, destitute woman, deserted woman, adolescent girl, differently abled woman, or a woman from socially and economically backward sections
The woman can stay with her male child up to 5th standard and with her girl child up to 12th standard in the service home
benefits_summary: Provides accommodation, food, education, vocational training and free supplies such as textbooks, uniforms and sanitary napkins.
